ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpMove Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of SharpMove, a .NET utility performing multiple tasks such as "Task Creation", "SCM" query, VBScript execution using WMI via its PE metadata and command line options.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpMove\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SharpMove\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*computername\\=.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=create.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=dcom.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=executevbs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=hijackdcom.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=modschtask.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=modsvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=query.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=scm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=startservice.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=taskscheduler.*")))
